children: Alcoa raised $2.6 billion through two senior notes offerings to fund the cash portion of its proposed acquisition of South32 interests and related fees. The company issued $1.5 billion of 6.625% notes due 2034 and $1.1 billion of 6.875% notes due 2036, each guaranteed by Alcoa and certain subsidiaries and carrying customary covenants and redemption features. Concurrently, Alcoa terminated all remaining commitments under its 364-day bridge term loan facility, shifting from temporary to permanent financing.
